movie.title: You Don't Belong Here
movie.overview: Marius is the chief medical officer at a hospital in his small hometown, raising a teenage son, Ioan, alone after the death of his wife. He is a confident professional, who has no idea what his son gets up to at night, cycling through town vandalising cars with a gang of masked vigilantes. Marius’s world is shaken when he learns that the police have come to suspect his son of murder.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A widowed doctor's life unravels when he discovers his quiet teenage son is suspected by the police of committing a murder.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Marius is a confident chief medical officer in his small hometown, balancing his demanding career while raising his teenage son, Ioan, following his wife's death. Unbeknownst to Marius, Ioan leads a double life at night, roaming the streets and vandalizing cars with a group of masked vigilantes. Marius's carefully constructed world shatters when a local tragedy strikes and the police name his son as the primary murder suspect. Forced to confront his own blindness to Ioan's secret life, Marius must navigate mounting suspicion and protect what remains of his family.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a close-knit hometown, Marius serves as a highly respected chief medical officer, dedicated both to his hospital patients and to raising his teenage son, Ioan, after the tragic passing of his wife. To Marius, Ioan is a quiet, dependable youth rebuilding his life after losing his mother. However, beneath his compliant facade, Ioan escapes every night to join a ruthless gang of masked vigilantes who cycle through the town streets vandalizing vehicles and stirring unrest. Marius remains entirely oblivious to his son's rebellious nocturnal activities until local law enforcement reaches out to him with devastating news. A brutal murder has taken place in the community, and key evidence leads the police to suspect Ioan as the perpetrator. Shaken to his core, Marius is forced to reevaluate everything he thought he knew about his son and his own parenting. As gossip spreads through the small town, Marius desperately attempts to uncover the truth behind the crime while protecting Ioan from a criminal justice system closing in. Caught between professional duty, denial, and a father's fierce instinct, Marius must face the reality that he may no longer know the boy he raised.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of a small, quiet community, Marius is a dedicated chief medical officer raising his teenage son, Ioan, as a single father following the death of his wife. Confident in his parenting and deeply immersed in his demanding profession, Marius believes Ioan is coping well with their shared loss. In reality, Ioan harbors a hidden life, slipping out into the night to join a gang of masked vigilantes who cycle through town causing destruction and vandalizing vehicles. Marius's structured world is thrown into total disarray when the police launch an investigation into a local murder and identify Ioan as their prime suspect. As tension escalates within the town and evidence mounts, Marius is forced to confront the widening rift between himself and his son, testing the limits of paternal loyalty and the lengths a father will go to discover the truth.

story_structure.climax: A tense confrontation occurs where the evidence against Ioan comes to a head, forcing Marius to face the painful reality of who his son has become and make a critical choice to protect or expose him.
story_structure.conflict: Marius's structured life shatters when local law enforcement names Ioan as the primary suspect in a murder investigation.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the truth coming to light, Marius must reckon with the collapse of his former perceptions and navigate a fractured relationship with Ioan as they face the long-term consequences in their community.
story_structure.introduction: Marius, a confident chief medical officer and grieving widower in a small town, balances his demanding career while raising his teenage son, Ioan, who secretly participates in late-night vigilante vandalism with a masked gang.
story_structure.risingAction: As the police pressure builds, Marius is forced to navigate his growing doubts about his son, untangle Ioan's secret nocturnal activities, and protect his family while attempting to uncover the truth.
